extension.summary: Live ships on Sentinel-2 satellite maps of the water you choose
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a live shipping map. Set up to ten areas anywhere on the water, each with its own name and bounding box, switch each one on or off, and choose how many minutes the screen spends on each before moving to the next. The add-on subscribes to the public AIS stream for every enabled box at once, then draws the ships in the current area on a high-resolution Copernicus Sentinel-2 cloudless satellite mosaic from EOX, sharp enough to see harbours, locks and individual berths. Vessels are coloured by type and turned to their course; the panel on the right lists the ships currently in the box with their type, flag, speed, length and destination, and crossfades through photographs of them from Wikimedia Commons. The ten areas ship ready to use: Lake Superior, the Strait of Hormuz, San Diego, San Francisco Bay, Hawaii, the Singapore Strait, Rotterdam, the Panama Canal, the Suez Canal and New York Harbor. The edges of a box are padded only for the map so the image keeps its true proportions. A free API key from aisstream.io is required and is stored in the add-on settings. Ships, their details and their photos are cached in a small database in the add-on profile, so a vessel that stays in an area is not looked up again and a restart shows the last known positions while the stream reconnects. Any key, click or mouse move exits straight away.
extension.disclaimer: AIS positions are supplied by aisstream.io and are subject to its terms; the add-on sends your API key and the enabled bounding boxes to that service. The base map is the EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2025 mosaic (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025), rendered on demand by EOX IT Services GmbH and used non-commercially under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see https://s2maps.eu. Ship details and photographs are fetched from Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons; photographs remain under their own licences and are not redistributed with this add-on. The add-on is not affiliated with aisstream.io, EOX, ESA, Wikidata or Wikimedia. Add-on code: MIT.
